# Auto-adapt incoming upstream changes to Galaxy Edition.
# Format:  glob::sed-expression    (extended regex, applied only to files upstream changed)
# Put this file at .github/galaxy/rewrites.txt
#
# Swap upstream's accent color for Galaxy purple in any new/changed XAML or CSS:
# *.xaml::s/#0078D4/#7B2FF7/Ig
# *.css::s/#0078D4/#7B2FF7/Ig
# Rename branding strings anywhere in source:
# *.cs::s/LiberNT Edition/LiberNT: Galaxy Edition/g

# ---- LiberNT: Galaxy Edition ----------------------------------------------------------------
# Re-applied only to files upstream changed. Every rule is idempotent (safe to run twice).
# Note: in a replacement, \1 followed by digits is "group 1" then the digits (sed groups are single digit).

# Default wallpaper and default theme (boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf). Whatever upstream sets, Galaxy wins.
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Control Panel\\Desktop","Wallpaper",0x00020000,")[^"]*(")/\1%SystemRoot%\\Web\\Wallpaper\\Galaxy.png\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(ThemeManager","DllName",0x00020000,")[^"]*(")/\1%SystemRoot%\\Resources\\Themes\\Galaxy\\galaxy.msstyles\2/

# Default colour scheme: map the neutral/blue Win8 colours to the Galaxy palette (HKCU Control Panel\Colors).
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","ButtonDkShadow",2,")0 0 0(")/\15 5 26\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")0 120 215(")/\1123 47 247\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")128 128 128(")/\1154 148 200\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")16 16 16(")/\111 11 43\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")160 160 160(")/\1182 176 222\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")24 24 24(")/\116 16 52\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")240 240 240(")/\1234 230 255\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")32 32 32(")/\121 21 61\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")43 43 43(")/\129 29 75\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")48 48 48(")/\133 33 82\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")64 64 64(")/\158 58 124\2/
boot/bootdata/hivedef.inf::s/(Colors","[A-Za-z]+",2,")96 205 255(")/\1179 136 255\2/

# Fallback theme path used when no theme is configured.
dll/win32/syssetup/install.c::s/Themes\\\\Aero\\\\aero\.msstyles/Themes\\\\Galaxy\\\\galaxy.msstyles/g
base/applications/systemsettings/page_misc.cpp::s/Themes\\\\Aero\\\\aero\.msstyles/Themes\\\\Galaxy\\\\galaxy.msstyles/g

# Register the Galaxy theme in the build (adds one line only if it is missing).
media/themes/CMakeLists.txt:::a;$!{N;ba};/add_subdirectory\(Galaxy\)/!s/$/\nadd_subdirectory(Galaxy)/

# Product name: version resources, registry ProductName, installer text, boot menu.
sdk/include/reactos/version.rc::s/(REACTOS_DEFAULT_STR_PRODUCT_NAME +")[^"]*(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
*.rc::s/(VALUE "ProductName",[[:space:]]*")LiberNT Operating System(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/hivesft.inf::s/(CurrentVersion","ProductName",2,")[^"]*(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/txtsetup.sif::s/^(productname *= *")[^"]*(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/txtsetup.sif::s/^(cdname *= *")LiberNT( Installation Media")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/*.ini::s/^(TitleText=)LiberNT([[:space:]]*)$/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/bootcd.ini::s/^(LiveImg_RamDisk_Normal=")LiberNT(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/
boot/bootdata/livecd.ini::s/^(LiveCD=")LiberNT(")/\1LiberNT: Galaxy Edition\2/

# Shell frame dark palette and accent fallbacks (Settings, Explorer and other frame windows).
base/shell/shellframe/theme.cpp::s/RGB\(32, 32, 32\)/RGB(21, 21, 61)/g

base/shell/shellframe/theme.cpp::s/RGB\(0x1E, 0x1E, 0x1E\)/RGB(20, 20, 60)/g
base/shell/shellframe/theme.cpp::s/RGB\(0x4C, 0xC2, 0xFF\)/RGB(0xB6, 0x8D, 0xFB)/g
base/shell/shellframe/theme.cpp::s/RGB\(0x00, 0x67, 0xC0\)/RGB(0x69, 0x28, 0xD2)/g
